hamburg-sachsenwald-elbe-luebeck-canal.slogan: A 158 km loop out of Hamburg south-east edge
hamburg-sachsenwald-elbe-luebeck-canal.story: Forest shade, canal villages and a clean south-east escape. Out of Rothenburgsort and back again: 158 km, roughly 3 h 10 in the saddle. The stops in between: Sachsenwald forest road, Lauenburg old Elbe town, Mölln lake stop and Ratzeburg island.

scenicChapters.title: Mölln lake stop → Ratzeburg island coffee
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 10 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 30 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.
